QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_1

question.text: Fund selection criteria for a Cat III AIF should include:

answer.text: Manager track record, strategy, risk controls, service-provider quality, fee structure, alignment

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 256-261 (due diligence) and 337-340 (pitch book) cover investment strategy, team and manager track record, risk controls, service-provider review, fee structure, and alignment of interest as the relevant fund-selection criteria. The distributor code on page 344 reinforces alignment and disclosure expectations. The Trap: Narrow criteria (only AUM, only performance, or only fee) miss the broader set of DD dimensions described in the source. Note: The source framing covers the listed DD dimensions; specific weighted scoring models for fund assessment are not stated on the checked pages.
